data_fields.name: strict_versions
data_fields.donor_constant: true (new version must be greater; equal refused)

data_fields.name: name_charset
data_fields.donor_constant: letters, digits, '-' and '_' only; not empty

best_idea: Publish a content pack only after an ownership check, a strict version increase, a name and filename check and a case-collision check, in that order, each failure returning a named reason; ship later versions as name-and-hash deltas that the server can regenerate between consecutive versions.
decision_why: The gate order and reason codes fit zone and legend packs and our server-side publish; the shared per-pack passphrase and forum login are rejected because publishing is Dom-only, a server role, not a shared secret.
acceptance: A server publish test sends a zone pack named by case-variant of an existing pack, a pack with the same version, and a pack with two files colliding in lowercase; each is refused with its reason code and the live catalogue is unchanged.
